The '''Mid-Core''' was a region of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==Description==
[[File:Farorbitringaliee0.jpg|thumb|left|260px|The [[Ringali Shell]] was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that ran from the Mid-Core to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]]]
The Mid-Core was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="AJ7" />

The [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] was a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|major]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that ran from the Mid-Core out to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It intersected the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], in the [[Ringali Shell]].<ref name="AJ7" />

The Ringali Shell was situated between the Mid-Core and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="AJ7" />

The [[Nopces system/Legends|Nopces system]] was a minor [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> which was located on the Mid-Core edge of the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]], along the Hydian Way.<ref name="Shipment 1037">{{WEGCite|story=The Hijacking of Shipment 1037|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref>

==History==
The Mid-Core was a major exporter of raw materials. Most worlds in the Core imported their raw materials from the Mid-Core or beyond, as they had long ago depleted their own star systems of such resources.<ref name="AJ7" />

Between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="AJ3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref><ref name="AJ8">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> the [[Independent Traders' Infonet/Legends|Independent Traders' Infonet]] reported news from an unspecified Mid-Core node.<ref name="AJ5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Halbard]] was a notable shipping magistrate in the Mid-Core.<ref name="AJ7" />
